title: A novel differentiable predictive control (DPC) approach for safe and optimal EV charging and discharging scheduling
China's solar expansion policy reduces bird diversity
abstract: Could the global transition to renewable energy create a green dilemma that pits carbon reduction against biodiversity conservation? This study examined the effect of policies promoting solar photovoltaics on local avian biodiversity using a panel dataset covering 2344 counties in China from 2014 to 2023. Policies that favored photovoltaic expansion led to reductions in bird diversity, disproportionately affecting wealthier and nondesert regions, as well as widespread species. The mechanism operated primarily through land conversion: Cropland and grassland were transformed into developed areas, reducing the diversity of vegetation. Paradoxically, the leaf area index increased, a pattern we term “inferior greening,” whereby diverse natural landscapes were replaced by dense but ecologically homogeneous vegetation. We argue that future photovoltaic development should be accompanied by strict biodiversity safeguards, especially in economically developed regions with high habitat complexity.
abstract_zh: 全球向可再生能源的转型，是否会制造一种使碳减排与生物多样性保护相互对立的“绿色困境”？本研究利用2014—2023年覆盖中国2344个县的面板数据，考察了促进太阳能光伏发展的政策对当地鸟类多样性的影响。有利于光伏扩张的政策导致鸟类多样性下降，且对较富裕地区、非沙漠地区以及分布广泛的物种影响尤为明显。其作用机制主要通过土地转换实现：耕地和草地被转为建设用地，导致植被多样性降低。矛盾的是，叶面积指数（LAI）反而上升，我们将这一模式称为“劣质绿化”（inferior greening），即多样化的自然景观被密集但生态上同质化的植被所取代。我们认为，未来的光伏开发应配套严格的生物多样性保障措施，特别是在经济发达、栖息地复杂度高的地区。

title: Estimation of Property Value Changes from Nearby Carbon Capture, Utilization, and Storage Projects in the United States
abstract: Carbon capture, utilization, and storage (CCUS) is vital to decarbonization, but its socioeconomic impact on nearby communities remains understudied. Using property-level housing transaction data (1990–2021) matched to nationwide CCUS project records, we apply a hedonic difference-in-differences framework to quantify the net impact of CCUS proximity on nearby housing prices. CCUS operations generate a price premium of 3.90% ($8582 on average) for homes within 4.2 km, with no effect beyond this distance. Effects vary by facility type and distance: capture facilities raise values at moderate distances (3–4.2 km), consistent with spillovers from job creation, while storage facilities generate more localized premiums within 1 km, reflecting direct financial compensation to nearby landowners. These estimates reflect the incremental effect of CCUS equipment on housing prices near the host facility, not the net effect of the plant plus CCUS relative to no facility at all, and could differ if the two were considered jointly. A triple-difference comparison against matched non-CCUS facilities of the same industry and scale confirms that CCUS itself, rather than the presence of an industrial facility generally, drives this incremental effect. Our findings provide revealed-preference evidence that communities perceive a net positive value from nearby CCUS projects, informing siting and benefit-sharing policy.
abstract_zh: 碳捕集、利用与封存（CCUS）对脱碳至关重要，但其对周边社区的社会经济影响仍研究不足。本文利用1990—2021年房产层面的住房交易数据，并将其与全国CCUS项目记录进行匹配，应用特征价格（hedonic）双重差分框架，量化CCUS临近程度对周边房价的净影响。CCUS运营使距离4.2公里以内的住房价格溢价3.90%（平均为8582美元），超出该距离则无影响。效应因设施类型和距离而异：捕集设施在中等距离（3–4.2公里）内提升房产价值，这与就业创造带来的溢出效应相一致；而封存设施则在1公里以内产生更为局部的溢价，反映出对邻近土地所有者的直接经济补偿。这些估计反映的是CCUS设备在宿主设施附近对房价的增量效应，而非设施加CCUS相对于无设施情形的净效应；若将二者联合考虑，结果可能有所不同。与同行业、同规模的匹配非CCUS设施进行的三重差分比较证实，驱动这一增量效应的是CCUS本身，而非一般意义上的工业设施。我们的研究结果提供了显示性偏好证据，表明社区认为临近CCUS项目具有正的净价值，可为选址和利益共享政策提供参考。

title: Management attention to climate risk reduces corporate greenwashing through green innovation
abstract: Amid intensifying climate risks and stricter environmental regulations in China, sustainability disclosure is expanding, alongside growing concerns about greenwashing. Existing research emphasizes external pressures, while the role of managerial attention remains less understood. Here we show, using 7556 annual observations of Chinese listed companies from 2012 to 2022, that management attention to climate risk is associated with lower subsequent greenwashing. Further analyses show that this relationship is partly explained by green innovation: greater attention is associated with more granted green invention and utility patents, which in turn are linked to less future greenwashing. The negative relationship is stronger in firms with higher internal control quality, particularly asset safety controls. These findings suggest that climate-conscious management helps firms move from symbolic disclosure toward substantive environmental action. They also show how attention indicators and verifiable innovation outcomes, such as granted green patents, can help regulators and rating agencies distinguish firms that “walk the talk” from those relying on symbolic disclosure. Firms receiving greater managerial attention are less likely to engage in subsequent greenwashing, and this effect is partly driven by increased green patenting and is stronger in firms with high-quality internal controls, according to an analysis of Chinese A-share listed firms from 2012 to 2022.
abstract_zh: 在中国，随着气候风险加剧和环境监管趋严，企业可持续发展信息披露正在扩大，与此同时，对“漂绿”（greenwashing）的担忧也与日俱增。现有研究强调外部压力，而管理层关注所起的作用仍鲜为人知。本文利用中国上市公司2012—2022年的7556份年度观测数据表明，管理层对气候风险的关注与其后续的漂绿行为呈负相关。进一步分析显示，这一关系部分可由绿色创新来解释：更多的关注与更多获得授权的绿色发明专利和实用新型专利相关，而这些专利又与未来更少的漂绿行为相关。在内部控制质量较高的企业中，这种负相关更强，尤其是资产安全控制方面。这些发现表明，具有气候意识的管理有助于企业从象征性披露转向实质性的环境行动。研究还表明，注意力指标和可核实的创新成果（如获得授权的绿色专利）可以帮助监管机构和评级机构区分那些“言行一致”的企业与那些依赖象征性披露的企业。根据对2012—2022年中国A股上市公司的分析，获得管理层更多关注的企业，其后续漂绿的可能性更低；这一效应部分源于绿色专利申请的增加，并且在内部控制质量较高的企业中更为显著。

title: Impacts of heatwaves on electricity reliability: Evidence from power outage data in China
abstract: Heatwaves, driven by climate change, have increasingly challenged energy systems with increased demand and reduced supply, leading to power outages. This study empirically examines the impact of heatwaves on power outages, employing fixed-effects models and using high-frequency outage data from China (2019-2021). The results indicate that heatwaves increase the frequency of outages by 3.9%-4.0% and extend their duration by 7.9%-8.3%. Additionally, each degree of temperature rise increases outages by 0.1%, and an additional heatwave day raises outages by 0.5%. We also observed heterogeneity in outage impacts across different socio-demographic groups. Furthermore, projections under RCP2.6, RCP4.5, and RCP8.5 show that outages will increase by 5.2%-12.5% in 2030 and 7.4%-20.3% in 2050. These findings underscore the urgency of grid upgrades and provide insights for resource allocation to adaptation to climate change.
abstract_zh: 由气候变化驱动的热浪，以日益增长的需求和不断减少的供给，对能源系统提出了越来越大的挑战，并导致停电。本研究采用固定效应模型，利用中国2019—2021年的高频停电数据，实证考察热浪对停电的影响。结果表明，热浪使停电频次增加3.9%–4.0%，并使停电持续时间延长7.9%–8.3%。此外，气温每升高一度，停电次数增加0.1%；每增加一个热浪日，停电次数增加0.5%。我们还发现，不同社会人口群体所受停电影响存在异质性。此外，在RCP2.6、RCP4.5和RCP8.5情景下的预测显示，2030年停电将增加5.2%–12.5%，2050年将增加7.4%–20.3%。这些发现凸显了电网升级的紧迫性，并为气候变化适应中的资源配置提供了参考。

title: Quantifying grid resilience against extreme weather using large-scale customer power outage data
abstract:
In recent years, extreme weather events frequently cause large-scale power outages. Resilience, the capability of withstanding, adapting to, and recovering from a large-scale disruption, has become a top priority for the power sector. However, a system-level understanding of power grid resilience remains limited, with most studies yielding conceptual insights or focusing on isolated technical issues. Using a spatio-temporal model, this study adopts a data-driven approach and analyzes quarter-hourly, customer-level power outage data and corresponding weather records from three major service territories on the U.S. East Coast. Our findings reveal that excessive weather stress and planning vulnerabilities at specific grid nodes are key drivers of prolonged local outages, which propagate system-wide. Simulations show that targeted interventions, such as isolating critical nodes and protecting vulnerable nodes from transient faults, can reduce customer outages by 45.5% and 49.5%, respectively. These insights inform actionable strategies for decision makers to enhance grid resilience and mitigate future disruptions.
History: Bianca M. Colosimo served as the senior editor for this article.
Funding: This work is supported by the U.S. Department of Energy Advanced Grid Modeling Program [Grant DE-OE0000875].
Supplemental Material: The online appendices are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/ijds.2023.0017 .
abstract_zh:
近年来，极端天气事件频繁导致大规模停电。韧性（resilience），即抵御、适应并从大规模中断中恢复的能力，已成为电力部门的首要任务。然而，人们对电网韧性的系统性认识仍然有限，大多数研究要么提供概念性见解，要么仅关注孤立的技术问题。本研究采用时空模型和数据驱动的方法，分析了美国东海岸三大供电区域的每15分钟一次、以用户为单位的停电数据及相应的天气记录。研究发现，特定电网节点上过大的天气压力和规划脆弱性，是局部停电持续时间延长的关键驱动因素，并会在全系统范围内传播。模拟结果表明，有针对性的干预措施——例如隔离关键节点、保护易受瞬时故障影响的脆弱节点——可分别使用户停电减少45.5%和49.5%。这些见解可为决策者提供可操作的策略，以增强电网韧性并减轻未来的中断。

title: Seasonal energy burden and climate intervention co-benefits: A case study in Arizona
abstract: Cooling infrastructure, technologies, and nature-based interventions are critical components in mitigating heat-related risks, energy insecurity, and household carbon footprints. This study investigated whether various climate adaptation and mitigation interventions affect energy burden and how seasonality (i.e. changes across seasons) affects energy insecurity reductions. We focused on the following interventions within Arizona’s Salt River Project service area: air-conditioning (AC) adoption, rooftop photovoltaic (PV) with batteries, weatherization, and increased tree coverage. We developed a multi-model analysis using daily smart meter data from 2015–2018, weather data, housing and household survey data, and open-source models to simulate changes in household energy use. Our model produces estimates of energy consumption, cost, burden, and avoided emissions for both census tracts and building types. Our novel approach combines climate interventions, CO2 mitigation, and energy insecurity reductions, which have typically been isolated. We found that without intervention, energy burden for an average household ranges from 2% annually to 5.7% in fall and 10.7% in summer. Considering only annual energy burden is inadequate to represent seasonal variation. Across all scenarios, average savings were approximately $90, ranging from $0 to $247. Scenarios in which all energy-inefficient households adopted a rooftop PV system with a battery or were weatherized and adopted an efficient AC showed the largest savings. These scenarios demonstrated the most significant reductions: 1–3 metric tons of CO2 equivalent per household and 3–4 percentage points in burden reductions. When evaluating energy burden reduction per avoided metric ton, we found that achieving household emission reduction and energy equity goals necessitated combining interventions. This study revealed how households, cities, and utilities can collaborate to address rising temperatures and improve equity while reducing residential emissions. Our integrated model is generalizable to any utility or climate zone and can be used in conjunction with more traditional tools.
abstract_zh: 制冷基础设施、技术以及基于自然的干预措施，是缓解热相关风险、能源不安全和家庭碳足迹的关键组成部分。本研究考察了多种气候适应与减缓干预措施是否影响能源负担，以及季节性（即各季节的变化）如何影响能源不安全状况的改善。我们聚焦亚利桑那州盐河项目（Salt River Project）服务区内的以下干预措施：空调（AC）安装、带储能电池的屋顶光伏（PV）、房屋节能改造（weatherization）以及增加树木覆盖率。我们构建了一个多模型分析框架，使用2015—2018年的每日智能电表数据、天气数据、住房与家庭调查数据以及开源模型，模拟家庭能源使用的变化。模型可估算普查区和不同建筑类型层面的能源消费、成本、负担及避免的排放。我们的新方法将气候干预、CO2减排和能源不安全的减少结合起来，而这三者此前通常是分开研究的。研究发现，若不采取干预，普通家庭的能源负担在全年平均为2%，在秋季为5.7%，在夏季则高达10.7%。仅考虑年度能源负担不足以反映季节性变化。在所有情景中，平均节省约90美元，范围为0至247美元。所有高耗能家庭都安装带电池的屋顶光伏系统，或对房屋进行节能改造并安装高效空调的情景，节省效果最为显著。这些情景使每户家庭减少1–3公吨二氧化碳当量的排放，并使负担降低3–4个百分点。在评估每避免一公吨排放所带来的能源负担降低时，我们发现，要同时实现家庭减排和能源公平目标，需要将多种干预措施结合使用。本研究揭示了家庭、城市和公用事业公司如何协作，以应对气温上升、促进公平并减少居民排放。我们的综合模型可推广至任何公用事业公司或气候区，并可与更传统的工具结合使用。

Unequal power outages induced by natural disasters
abstract: Natural disasters increasingly threaten energy system reliability. However, little empirical research has examined the unequal impact of such events on power outages. Here, we employ a nationwide high-frequency point-level power outage and natural disasters dataset in China, spanning from 2019 to 2021, to empirically assess the impact of natural disasters on power outages. We focus on the poverty counties, identified by the Chinese government, based on income, infrastructure, geographical location, and other criteria. We find that these impacts of natural disasters on power outage are not distributed evenly between poverty counties (5.19% and 8.96% increase in frequency and duration, respectively) and non-poverty counties (3.80% and 5.34%). Long-term projections under SSP-RCP scenarios suggest that climate change exacerbates the disparity. This paper highlights the need for planners to evaluate disaster-induced outages in vulnerable regions to target climate funds to areas with the utmost necessity.
abstract_zh: 自然灾害对能源系统可靠性的威胁日益加剧。然而，很少有实证研究考察此类事件对停电的不均衡影响。本文利用中国2019—2021年全国范围的高频点位停电数据和自然灾害数据集，实证评估自然灾害对停电的影响。我们关注中国政府依据收入、基础设施、地理位置及其他标准认定的贫困县。研究发现，自然灾害对停电的影响在贫困县与非贫困县之间分布并不均匀：贫困县的停电频次和持续时间分别增加5.19%和8.96%，非贫困县则分别增加3.80%和5.34%。SSP-RCP情景下的长期预测表明，气候变化将加剧这一差距。本文强调，规划者需要评估自然灾害引发的停电在脆弱地区的影响，从而将气候资金精准投向最亟需的地区。

title: Uneven effects of global trade on transportation industry sustainability
abstract: The global trade in transportation industry has complex socio-economic, resource, and environmental (SRE) footprints. Linking these footprints with sustainability frameworks is crucial for driving transportation industry sustainability (TI-S). Here, we analyze these footprints and develop a TI-S assessment system with 26 SRE indicators for 16 TI-S targets. We find that global trade increases TI-S scores; developed economies excel in resource and environmental targets, developing economies progress more in employment and tax targets. For South Africa, Russia, and Australia, improvements in the socio-economic target scores do not offset decreases in resource and environmental target scores. In terms of interaction between the targets, global trade enhances synergies among the 16 targets in developed economies; this is not consistently the case for developing economies. These findings highlight the heterogeneous impact of trade on TI-S. The paper closes by proposing measures to promote TI-S progress, which could help inform adjustments in industrial policies.
abstract_zh: 全球交通运输行业的贸易伴随着复杂的社会经济、资源与环境（SRE）足迹。将这些足迹与可持续发展框架相联系，对于推动交通运输行业的可持续发展（TI-S）至关重要。本文分析了这些足迹，并构建了一套包含26项SRE指标、针对16个TI-S目标的评估体系。我们发现，全球贸易提高了TI-S得分：发达经济体在资源和环境目标方面表现突出，而发展中经济体在就业和税收目标方面进展更快。对于南非、俄罗斯和澳大利亚而言，社会经济目标得分的改善，无法抵消资源和环境目标得分的下降。就各目标之间的相互作用而言，全球贸易增强了发达经济体中16个目标之间的协同效应；而在发展中经济体中，情况并非始终如此。这些发现凸显了贸易对TI-S影响的异质性。本文最后提出了促进TI-S进展的措施，以期为调整产业政策提供参考。

title: What drives embodied carbon policy? A global perspective on adoption
abstract: Embodied carbon refers to the greenhouse gas emission associated with the lifecycle of buildings. Embodied carbon policies are critical for addressing the environmental impact of construction materials and advancing climate goals. Despite their importance, the adoption of embodied carbon policies has been limited globally, influenced by economic, environmental, institutional, and trade factors. This study employs structural equation modeling to analyze 37 countries, testing ten hypotheses across four categorical factors. The base model reveals the significant influence of environmental vulnerability and institutional frameworks on policy adoption, while robustness models confirm the critical role of trade dependencies and economic competitiveness in shaping national embodied carbon strategies. Findings underscore that countries with high climate vulnerability and strong institutional support are more likely to adopt embodied carbon policies. Conversely, trade-reliant nations face challenges balancing competitiveness and sustainability. Policy implications suggest the need for international collaboration to align trade policies with carbon reduction goals, targeted support for vulnerable nations, and the integration of embodied carbon considerations into existing climate frameworks. These results offer a roadmap for policymakers to design more effective and equitable embodied carbon policies, fostering global progress toward sustainable construction and decarbonization.
abstract_zh: 隐含碳（Embodied carbon）是指建筑全生命周期中所产生的温室气体排放。隐含碳政策对于应对建筑材料的环境影响、推进气候目标至关重要。尽管其重要性不言而喻，但全球范围内隐含碳政策的采纳仍然有限，受到经济、环境、制度和贸易等因素的影响。本研究采用结构方程模型，分析37个国家，检验了四类分类因素下的十项假设。基础模型显示，环境脆弱性和制度框架对政策采纳具有显著影响；稳健性模型则证实，贸易依赖和经济竞争力在塑造各国隐含碳战略中具有关键作用。研究结果表明，气候脆弱性高且制度支持力度强的国家更有可能采纳隐含碳政策。相反，依赖贸易的国家在平衡竞争力与可持续性方面面临挑战。政策启示包括：需要开展国际合作，使贸易政策与碳减排目标保持一致；为脆弱国家提供有针对性的支持；并将隐含碳考量纳入现有气候框架。这些结果为决策者设计更有效、更公平的隐含碳政策提供了路线图，推动建筑行业实现可持续发展和脱碳的全球进程。

title: Assessing inequities in electrification via heat pumps across the US
abstract: Heat pumps are an energy-efficient and increasingly cost-effective solution for reducing greenhouse gas emissions in the building sector. However, other clean energy technologies, such as rooftop solar, are less likely to be adopted in underserved communities, and thus policies incentivizing their adoption may funnel support to well-resourced communities. Unlike previously studied technologies, the effects of heat pumps on household energy bills may be positive or negative depending on local climate, energy costs, building features, and other factors. Here, we propose a framework for assessing heat pump inequities across the US. We find that households in communities of color and with higher percentages of renters are less likely to use heat pumps across the board. Moreover, communities of color are least likely to use heat pumps in regions where they are most likely to reduce energy bills. Public policies must address these inequities to advance beneficial electrification and energy justice.
abstract_zh: 热泵是一种能效高、成本效益日益提升的方案，可用于减少建筑部门的温室气体排放。然而，屋顶太阳能等其他清洁能源技术在弱势社区中的采用率较低，因此，激励其采用的政策可能将支持资源导向条件较好的社区。与以往研究的技术不同，热泵对家庭能源账单的影响可能为正，也可能为负，取决于当地气候、能源价格、建筑特征及其他因素。在此，我们提出了一个评估美国热泵不平等问题的框架。我们发现，有色人种社区和租房者比例较高的社区，在各方面都不太可能使用热泵。此外，在热泵最有可能降低能源账单的地区，有色人种社区最不可能使用热泵。公共政策必须解决这些不平等问题，以推进有益的电气化和能源正义。

title: Comfort or cash? Lessons from the COVID-19 pandemic's impact on energy insecurity and energy limiting behavior in households
Effectiveness of carbon dioxide emission target is linked to country ambition and education level
abstract: In response to the Paris Agreement, a growing number of countries, 123 in total, have committed to carbon reduction targets. While existing research has assessed various policies’ effectiveness in achieving these targets, the potential of the act of goal-setting itself as a policy instrument has been underexplored. Here we leveraged a comprehensive panel dataset spanning 163 countries from 2011 to 2022 and employed a rigorous difference-in-difference model. Empirical findings reveal that both proposing carbon reduction targets and setting higher targets effectively reduce emissions intensity. The mechanism driving the impact of carbon reduction targets on CO2 emissions centers on the level of education, rather than renewable energy capacity, requiring further investigation to the mechanism. Subsequent analysis establishes connections between target levels and renewable energy capacity. Our results advocate for dynamic updates of carbon reduction targets aligned with renewable energy capacity when formulating climate objectives.
abstract_zh: 为响应《巴黎协定》，越来越多的国家（共计123个）已承诺设定碳减排目标。尽管已有研究评估了各类政策在实现这些目标方面的有效性，但设定目标这一行为本身作为一种政策工具的潜力仍未得到充分探讨。在此，我们利用涵盖163个国家、2011—2022年的综合面板数据，并采用严谨的双重差分模型进行分析。实证结果表明，提出碳减排目标和设定更高的目标，都能有效降低排放强度。碳减排目标影响CO2排放的机制主要在于教育水平，而非可再生能源装机容量，这一机制仍需进一步研究。随后的分析建立了目标水平与可再生能源装机容量之间的联系。我们的结果主张，在制定气候目标时，应根据可再生能源装机容量对碳减排目标进行动态更新。

title: Estimation of property value changes from nearby carbon capture and utilization projects in China
Power supply disruptions deter electric vehicle adoption in cities in China
abstract: Electrification plays a crucial role in deep decarbonization. However, electrification and power infrastructure can cause mutual challenges. We use nationwide power outage and electric vehicle adoption data in China to provide empirical evidence on how power infrastructure failures can deter electrification. We find that when the number of power outages per district increases by 1 in a given month, the number of new electric vehicles adopted per month decreases by 0.99%. A doubling of power outages in one year on average across the nation can create a depressed adoption rate for up to a decade, implying a decline of more than $ 31.3 million per year in carbon reduction benefits from electric vehicle adoptions. This paper adds to the policy discussion of the costs of increased power outages due to extreme weather and natural disasters, and the urgency for policy to address this issue to facilitate wide adoption of electrification.
abstract_zh: 电气化在深度脱碳中发挥着关键作用。然而，电气化与电力基础设施可能相互制约。我们利用中国全国范围的停电数据和电动汽车采用数据，为电力基础设施故障如何阻碍电气化提供了实证证据。我们发现，某一月份每个区的停电次数每增加1次，当月新增电动汽车的采用量便减少0.99%。全国范围内，若一年内停电次数翻倍，平均会导致电动汽车采用率在长达十年的时间内处于低迷状态，每年因电动汽车采用而产生的碳减排效益将减少超过3130万美元。本文为极端天气和自然灾害导致停电增加的成本这一政策讨论增添了新的内容，并论证了政府迫切需要制定政策以应对这一问题，从而促进电气化的广泛采用。

title: The economic consequences of local gas leaks with evidence from Massachusetts housing market
The unequal impacts of extremely high temperatures on households' adaptive behaviors: Empirical evidence from fine-grained electricity consumption data
Climate change impacts on future residential electricity consumption and energy burden: A case study in Phoenix, Arizona
abstract: Transitioning to an equitable electricity sector requires a deep understanding of a warming climate's impacts on vulnerable populations. A vital climate adaptation measure is deploying air-conditioning (AC), but AC use can increase household energy costs. We evaluate how a warming climate will affect regional energy equity by tying temperature projections with household temperature response functions derived from smart-meter electricity data in Phoenix, Arizona. We simulate future consumption changes under two climate change scenarios from 2020 to 2070, with and without AC efficiency upgrades. We find that the median elderly and low-income household percentage changes are nearly 5 percentage points higher than their counterparts after controlling for decadal, housing, and cooling infrastructural differences. Improving AC efficiency reduces cooling consumption by up to 70% for vulnerable groups. However, a disproportionate share of racial minorities (Hispanic (21%), Black (18%), Asian (12%)) have energy burdens above 6%, indicating affordability challenges. The energy justice implications of this work suggest that intentional considerations of how technology adoption will affect energy affordability and cooling needs are imperative for households to adapt to a warming climate. Such insights are essential for mitigating risk in vulnerable populations, given that policies often rely on ACs as a primary extreme-heat adaptation strategy.
abstract_zh: 迈向公平的电力部门，需要深入理解气候变暖对弱势群体的影响。空调（AC）的普及是一项重要的气候适应措施，但空调使用会增加家庭能源成本。我们利用亚利桑那州凤凰城智能电表数据推导出的家庭温度响应函数，将温度预测与之相结合，以评估气候变暖将如何影响区域能源公平。我们模拟了2020—2070年两种气候变化情景下，有空调效率升级和无空调效率升级两种情况的未来用电变化。在控制了年代、住房及制冷基础设施的差异后，我们发现，中位数的老年家庭和低收入家庭的用电变化百分比，比其对照群体高出近5个百分点。提高空调效率可使弱势群体的制冷用电减少多达70%。然而，少数族裔中有相当大比例的家庭能源负担超过6%，其中西班牙裔占21%、黑人占18%、亚裔占12%，这表明存在可负担性挑战。这项研究的能源正义启示在于，有意识地考虑技术采用将如何影响能源可负担性和制冷需求，对于家庭适应气候变暖至关重要。鉴于政策往往将空调作为极端高温适应的主要策略，这些洞见对于降低弱势群体的风险至关重要。

title: Consumer reaction to green subsidy phase-out in China: Evidence from the household photovoltaic industry
Effects of expanding electric vehicle charging stations in California on the housing market
Forgone summertime comfort as a function of avoided electricity use
abstract: Broadly, energy poverty is defined as insufficient energy access. One often missed sign of energy poverty is an inability to maintain a safe and comfortable indoor temperature. We add to the literature by quantifying the cooling slope gap (i.e., amount of electricity households forgo over the cooling season). We first map a household's electricity consumption across outdoor temperatures using a five-parameter regression model. Next, we identify the household's cooling slope as how much additional electricity they consume per 1 °F increase in outdoor temperature once they start using their air conditioning systems. Using these slopes, we quantify the cooling slope gap in our study region (Arizona). We find that households making less than $15,000 limit their electricity consumption for cooling by 1.03 kWh per 1 °F increase compared to high-income households. For households with the same air conditioning count and efficiency, the cooling slope gap is 0.52 kWh/°F on average, with a maximum of 0.84 kWh/°F. This implies that these households are continuously using coping strategies throughout the cooling season to reduce financial energy poverty but may be putting themselves a heat-illness risk. This finding helps energy poverty mitigation efforts by identifying who is potentially experiencing financial instability or lacks cooling infrastructure.
abstract_zh: 广义而言，能源贫困被定义为能源获取不足。一个常被忽视的能源贫困信号，是无法维持安全、舒适的室内温度。我们通过量化“制冷斜率缺口”（即家庭在制冷季中放弃的用电量），为相关文献增添新的内容。我们首先使用五参数回归模型，描绘家庭用电量随室外温度的变化。随后，我们将家庭的制冷斜率定义为：一旦开始使用空调，室外温度每升高1°F，其额外增加的用电量。利用这些斜率，我们量化了研究区域（亚利桑那州）的制冷斜率缺口。研究发现，年收入低于15,000美元的家庭，与高收入家庭相比，室外温度每升高1°F，其制冷用电量少1.03千瓦时。对于空调数量和效率相同的家庭，制冷斜率缺口平均为0.52千瓦时/°F，最大为0.84千瓦时/°F。这表明，这些家庭在整个制冷季持续采取应对策略以减少经济上的能源贫困，但可能因此面临中暑风险。这一发现有助于能源贫困缓解工作，明确哪些人可能正经历经济不稳定，或缺乏制冷基础设施。

title: Incentive based emergency demand response effectively reduces peak load during heatwave without harm to vulnerable groups
Increasing voluntary enrollment in time-of-use electricity rates: Findings from a survey experiment
Inequalities across cooling and heating in households: Energy equity gaps
abstract: Understanding the degree of energy limiting behavior in low-income and vulnerable households is vital to eradicating energy poverty and associated negative health effects. We estimate the outdoor temperatures at which households turn on and off their electricity-based cooling and heating units under a cold climate in northern Illinois, USA (N = 418,255 for cooling; N = 22,628 for electric heating). We find that the cooling energy equity gap between low and high income groups is 3 °F (1.7 °C), while the electric-based heating energy equity gap is 6 °F (3.3 °C). The pattern of energy limiting behavior is found to be different between the cooling season and the heating season. Our metrics contribute to the policy design of home energy bill and weatherization assistance programs to identify vulnerable households in a cold climate: Among low-to-middle-income households, our metric identifies 19,001 households (20%) in the cooling sector and 1,290 households (24%) in the heating sector who may be neglected by the traditional income-based energy poverty measure. We also find that households living in black-majority census block groups have a cooling gap that is 17% wider than households living in white-majority census block groups. Policy design should focus on addressing the income inequality and other systematic inequalities that have impacted Black American households.
abstract_zh: 了解低收入和弱势家庭的能源限制行为程度，对于消除能源贫困及其相关的负面健康影响至关重要。我们在美国伊利诺伊州北部的寒冷气候条件下，估计了家庭开启和关闭电力制冷及供暖设备时的室外温度（制冷样本N=418,255；电供暖样本N=22,628）。研究发现，低收入与高收入群体之间的制冷能源公平缺口为3°F（1.7°C），而基于电力的供暖能源公平缺口为6°F（3.3°C）。能源限制行为的模式在制冷季和供暖季之间存在差异。我们的指标有助于家庭能源账单补贴和住宅节能改造援助项目的政策设计，以识别寒冷气候中的弱势家庭：在中低收入家庭中，我们的指标在制冷部门识别出19,001户（20%），在供暖部门识别出1,290户（24%），而这些家庭可能被传统的基于收入的能源贫困度量所忽视。我们还发现，居住在黑人占多数的普查街区组的家庭，其制冷缺口比居住在白人占多数的街区组的家庭大17%。政策设计应着眼于解决收入不平等以及对美国黑人家庭造成影响的其他系统性不平等。

title: Pandemics erode poverty alleviation process: Impact on productive livelihood and poverty return
Review of application of high frequency smart meter data in energy economics and policy research
abstract: The rapid popularization of advanced metering infrastructure (AMI) smart meters produces customer high-frequency energy consumption data. These data provide diverse options for energy economics and policy research. In this review, we examine studies applying high frequency smart meter data to explore the overall impact of household new technology adoption and COVID-19 on energy consumption patterns. We find that high frequency smart meter data boosts the accuracy of forecasting models with various data-driven algorithms. In addition, there is a lack of precise assessment and inclusive understanding of energy poverty in advanced economics. Smart meter data help expand and deepen the energy poverty research. Research on how vulnerable groups exhibit energy poverty can improve society's understanding of energy poverty and help implement related policy assistance programs.
abstract_zh: 先进计量基础设施（AMI）智能电表的快速普及，产生了用户高频能源消费数据。这些数据为能源经济学和政策研究提供了多样化的选择。在本综述中，我们考察了运用高频智能电表数据探讨家庭采用新技术以及COVID-19对能源消费模式的整体影响的研究。我们发现，借助各类数据驱动算法，高频智能电表数据能够提高预测模型的准确性。此外，在发达经济体中，对能源贫困的精确评估和包容性理解仍然不足。智能电表数据有助于拓展和深化能源贫困研究。研究弱势群体如何表现出能源贫困，有助于增进社会对能源贫困的认识，并有助于实施相关的政策援助项目。

title: Rising US Income Inequality and Declining Residential Electricity Consumption: Is There a Link?
abstract: After growing steadily for decades, average U.S. household energy consumption began declining in the mid-2000s. Using household-level data from the Residential Energy Consumption Survey and Current Population Survey between 1990 and 2020, we decompose overall changes in per household consumption into three components: average income, cross-household income distribution, and consumption habits, which include energy efficiency. Growth of average income caused consumption to increase by 11%, and rising income inequality reduced consumption by 8%, nearly entirely offsetting the effect of income growth. Changes in habits also reduced consumption. Back-of-the-envelope calculations indicate an unexpected effect of rising income inequality: climate and air quality improvements valued at $9 billion in 2020 due to lower electricity consumption. The results indicate the importance of coordinating policies that address inequality and pollution.
abstract_zh: 在数十年稳步增长之后，美国家庭平均能源消费自2000年代中期开始下降。利用1990至2020年间住宅能源消费调查（RECS）和当前人口调查（CPS）的住户层面数据，我们将每户消费的总体变化分解为三个组成部分：平均收入、家庭间收入分配，以及消费习惯（包括能源效率）。平均收入的增长使消费增加了11%，而收入不平等的加剧使消费减少了8%，几乎完全抵消了收入增长的效应。消费习惯的变化同样减少了消费。粗略估算表明，收入不平等加剧还产生了一个意想不到的效应：由于电力消费减少，2020年价值90亿美元的气候与空气质量改善。研究结果表明，协调解决不平等与污染问题的政策十分重要。

title: The impact of co-adopting electric vehicles, solar photovoltaics, and battery storage on electricity consumption patterns: Empirical evidence from Arizona
Changes in hourly electricity consumption under COVID mandates: A glance to future hourly residential power consumption pattern with remote work in Arizona
abstract: The transition to remote work brings uncertainty to the future power consumption pattern. The COVID mandates in 2020 have accelerated the transition to remote work, generating major uncertainty regarding how residential power consumption patterns will shift. Understanding these shifts is vital for regional operators who will need to implement long-term planning strategies if companies continue to adopt remote work practices. Additionally, if new COVID variants prompt extended stay-at-home mandates, the resulting behavior shifts will decide the optimal combination of power generation in a region. Our study examines changes in hourly residential power consumption patterns resulting from COVID mandates in Arizona. We estimate how the COVID mandates and subsequent remote work practices could change the power consumption patterns using individual-consumer-level hourly power consumption data for 6,309 consumers and a machine learning framework. We also simulate how the hourly power consumption pattern will change with increasing penetration of remote work under winter and summer temperature settings. We then use our simulations to test the policy effectiveness of changing time-of-use (TOU) rates. Our results show that COVID mandates likely increase the power consumption in the afternoon by 13%, and can change the power consumption pattern in winter from a two-peaked shape to a one-peaked shape. Furthermore, we show that the residents' income, race, and house size are significantly correlated with the changes in power consumption, and the correlation is not linear. We find that, by increasing the peak hour prices and decreasing the off-peak hour prices by 10% of the TOU pricing, the peak electricity demand could be reduced by 10%. Our results show under the new remote work era: (1) the need for modifying previous energy generation combination planning due to changing peak demand hours; (2) equity concerns regarding TOU pricing and the inability of vulnerable groups to shift electricity consumption; (3) the ability of governments and utilities to lower the maximum load of power consumption by modifying the TOU rates.
abstract_zh: 向远程办公的转变给未来的电力消费模式带来了不确定性。2020年的COVID-19限制措施加速了向远程办公的转变，使居民电力消费模式将如何变化存在重大不确定性。若企业继续采用远程办公方式，区域运营商就需要制定长期规划策略，因此理解这些变化至关重要。此外，若新的COVID变种促使延长居家令，由此产生的行为变化将决定一个地区的最优发电组合。本研究考察了亚利桑那州COVID限制措施导致的居民每小时用电模式变化。我们利用6,309名用户的个体层面每小时用电数据和机器学习框架，估计COVID限制措施及随后的远程办公实践可能如何改变用电模式。我们还模拟了在冬季和夏季气温条件下，随着远程办公渗透率提高，每小时用电模式将如何变化。随后，我们利用模拟结果检验调整分时电价（TOU）的政策效果。结果显示，COVID限制措施可能使下午的用电量增加13%，并可能使冬季用电模式由双峰形态转变为单峰形态。此外，我们发现居民的收入、种族和住房面积与用电变化显著相关，且这种相关关系并非线性。我们发现，将分时电价的高峰时段价格提高10%、低谷时段价格降低10%，可使高峰用电需求减少10%。我们的结果表明，在新的远程办公时代：（1）由于高峰时段发生变化，需要调整以往的能源发电组合规划；（2）分时电价存在公平问题，弱势群体难以转移用电；（3）政府和公用事业公司可以通过调整分时电价来降低最大负荷。

title: Commercial consumers pay attention to marginal prices or average prices? Implications for energy conservation policies
Do political connections affect corporate poverty alleviation decisions? Evidence from China
Empirical grid impact of in-home electric vehicle charging differs from predictions
Field experimental evidence of how social relations shape behavior that promotes energy conservation
abstract: Energy demand-side management is essential for deep decarbonization. However, while we target people as discrete and isolated individuals, we ignore the fact that energy consumption occurs in intricate webs of pre-existing social relations. This study examines an emergency demand response (EDR) program in China involving more than 180,000 households based on relations with family members, communities, and identity. The results indicate that the existence of social relations can promote energy conservation behavior and there is a large degree of heterogeneity. Targeted relations, such as single-living residents, small-scale households, city dweller etc., show greater electricity savings with 12.35% increase in overall effect, which benefit when demographics change in the next few decades. Such heterogeneous changes put forward the pressing need for policymakers to focus on social relations as a unit in future intervention designs to decarbonize the energy system.
abstract_zh: 能源需求侧管理对于深度脱碳至关重要。然而，我们在针对个体时，往往忽视了一个事实：能源消费发生在既有的错综复杂的社会关系网络之中。本研究考察了中国一项涉及超过18万户家庭的紧急需求响应（EDR）项目，该项目基于家庭成员、社区和身份认同等关系展开。结果表明，社会关系的存在能够促进节能行为，且存在较大的异质性。对于独居居民、小规模家庭、城市居民等特定关系群体，节电效果更为显著，总体效应提高了12.35%；随着未来几十年人口结构的变化，这些群体的节电效应将更加突出。这种异质性变化表明，政策制定者迫切需要在未来的干预设计中，将社会关系作为一个单元加以关注，以实现能源系统的脱碳。

title: Heterogeneous changes in electricity consumption patterns of residential distributed solar consumers due to battery storage adoption
abstract: This study provides an empirical assessment of how adopting battery storage units can change the electricity consumption patterns of PV consumers using individual-consumer-level hourly smart meter data in Arizona, United States. We find that on average after adding batteries, PV consumers use more solar electricity to power their houses and send less solar electricity back to the grid. In addition, adding battery storage reduces electricity needed from the grid during system peak hours, helping utilities better flatten the load curves. Most importantly, we find a large degree of heterogeneity in the changes in electricity consumption patterns due to adopting battery storage that are not consistent with engineering or economic principles such as those not maximizing consumers' economic benefits. Such heterogeneous changes imply that utilities and policymakers need to further study the underlying behavioral reasons in order to maximize the social benefits of battery storage and PV co-adoption.
abstract_zh: 本研究利用美国亚利桑那州个体层面的每小时智能电表数据，实证评估了加装储能电池如何改变光伏用户的用电模式。我们发现，平均而言，加装电池后，光伏用户更多地使用太阳能供应自家住房，并减少向电网回送的太阳能电力。此外，增加储能电池可减少系统高峰时段对电网电力的需求，有助于公用事业公司使负荷曲线更为平缓。最重要的是，我们发现，加装电池导致的用电模式变化存在较大的异质性，且这些变化与工程或经济原理并不一致，例如未能最大化用户的经济效益。这种异质性变化表明，公用事业公司和政策制定者需要进一步研究其背后的行为原因，以最大化电池与光伏共同采用所带来的社会效益。

title: Impacts of electric-driven heat pumps on residential energy consumption: An empirical analysis from Arizona, USA
abstract: Heat pumps play an important role in the electrification of the residential sector. The electrification of building energy consumption can have a significant impact on the load management of the electric grid. This study provides the first empirical investigation of the changes in hour-of-day loads after adopting heat pumps. We apply unique hourly electricity data for 13,010 residential consumers in Arizona during 2014–2019. Statistical matching, fixed effects regression, and difference-in-differences approach are applied to analyze electricity consumption. Contrary to the predictions from engineering models which indicate energy savings after heat pump adoption, our main analysis suggests that heat pumps do not necessarily save electricity for cooling and heating in Arizona. Besides, we also quantify the increase in electricity consumption when switching from natural gas furnaces to heat pumps. The increased environmental damages from electricity changes are estimated to be $0.59 per household during the summer and $1.64 during the winter. This also indicates an increase for electric loads by 8.8 (2.7) MW in the winter (summer) if all SRP utility consumers shifted to heat pumps. The findings have implications for the energy performance of heat pumps at households. The results could also help improve the sustainability of the electric sector, which can integrate more clean energy into a smarter grid.
abstract_zh: 热泵在住宅部门电气化中发挥着重要作用。建筑能源消费的电气化可能对电网的负荷管理产生重大影响。本研究首次对采用热泵后每日各时段负荷的变化进行了实证考察。我们使用亚利桑那州13,010户居民用户在2014—2019年间的独特小时用电数据，并运用统计匹配、固定效应回归和双重差分方法分析用电消费。与工程模型预测的节能结果相反，我们的主要分析表明，在亚利桑那州，热泵不一定能节省制冷和供暖用电。此外，我们还量化了从天然气炉改用热泵后用电量的增加。由用电变化导致的额外环境损害估计为：夏季每户0.59美元，冬季每户1.64美元。若SRP公用事业公司的所有用户均改用热泵，冬季（夏季）电力负荷将增加8.8（2.7）兆瓦。这些发现对家庭热泵的能效表现具有启示意义。研究结果还有助于提高电力部门的可持续性，使其能够将更多清洁能源整合进更智能的电网。

title: Impacts of the co-adoption of electric vehicles and solar panel systems: Empirical evidence of changes in electricity demand and consumer behaviors from household smart meter data
Integrating sustainability into climate finance by quantifying the co-benefits and market impact of carbon projects
abstract: High-quality development rooted in low-carbon growth, new jobs, energy security, and environmental quality will be a critical part of achieving multiple sustainable development goals (SDGs). Doing this will require the dramatic scaling up of new climate finance while maximizing co-benefits across multiple outcomes, including for local communities. We developed a comprehensive methodology to identify different levels of local co-benefits, followed by an econometric analysis to assess how the market values co-benefits through the clean development mechanism. We find that projects with a likelihood of delivering the highest co-benefits received a 30.4% higher price compared to projects with the lowest co-benefits. Project quality indicators such as the Gold Standard, in conveying higher likelihood of co-benefits, conferred a significant price premium between 6.6% and 29%. Our methodology of aligning co-benefits with SDGs and the results of co-benefits valued by the markets indicate approaches to bolstering social and political support for climate finance.
abstract_zh: 以低碳增长、新就业、能源安全和环境质量为基础的高质量发展，将是实现多项可持续发展目标（SDGs）的关键组成部分。要做到这一点，需要大幅扩大新的气候融资规模，同时最大化多重结果的协同效益，包括对当地社区的效益。我们开发了一套综合方法，用以识别不同层级的地方协同效益，随后进行计量经济分析，以评估市场如何通过清洁发展机制（CDM）为协同效益定价。我们发现，最有可能带来最高协同效益的项目，其价格比协同效益最低的项目高出30.4%。金标准（Gold Standard）等项目质量指标，在体现更高协同效益可能性方面，带来了6.6%至29%的显著价格溢价。我们将协同效益与可持续发展目标相结合的方法，以及市场对协同效益定价的结果，为增强社会和政治对气候融资的支持提供了思路。

The discrepancies in the impacts of COVID-19 lockdowns on electricity consumption in China: Is the short-term pain worth it?

Unveiling hidden energy poverty using the energy equity gap
abstract:
Income-based energy poverty metrics ignore people’s behavior patterns, particularly reducing energy consumption to limit financial stress. We investigate energy-limiting behavior in low-income households using a residential electricity consumption dataset. We first determine the outdoor temperature at which households start using cooling systems, the inflection temperature. Our relative energy poverty metric, the
energy equity gap
, is defined as the difference in the inflection temperatures between low and high-income groups. In our study region, we estimate the energy equity gap to be between 4.7–7.5 °F (2.6–4.2 °C). Within a sample of 4577 households, we found 86 energy-poor and 214 energy-insecure households. In contrast, the income-based energy poverty metric, energy burden (10% threshold), identified 141 households as energy-insecure. Only three households overlap between our energy equity gap and the income-based measure. Thus, the energy equity gap reveals a hidden but complementary aspect of energy poverty and insecurity.
abstract_zh: 基于收入的能源贫困度量忽视了人们的行为模式，尤其是人们为缓解财务压力而减少能源消费的行为。我们利用居民电力消费数据集，考察低收入家庭的能源限制行为。我们首先确定家庭开始使用制冷系统的室外温度，即拐点温度（inflection temperature）。我们的相对能源贫困度量指标——能源公平缺口（energy equity gap）——定义为低收入组与高收入组之间拐点温度的差值。在本研究区域，我们估计能源公平缺口在4.7–7.5°F（2.6–4.2°C）之间。在4577户家庭的样本中，我们识别出86户能源贫困家庭和214户能源不安全家庭。相比之下，基于收入的能源贫困度量（能源负担，10%阈值）仅将141户家庭识别为能源不安全家庭。我们的能源公平缺口与基于收入的度量之间仅有三户家庭重叠。因此，能源公平缺口揭示了能源贫困与能源不安全中一个隐蔽但互补的维度。

title: Using agrophotovoltaics to reduce carbon emissions and global rural poverty
abstract: Poverty-alleviation programs using solar energy (PAPSE) are poised to unlock unprecedented capital investments with significant potential to reconcile the energy–poverty–climate nexus.1 These programs are economically feasible because the costs of generating renewable energy have declined precipitously over the past decade; between 2010 and 2019, solar photovoltaic costs decreased by 82%. Furthermore, the number of annual equivalent-use hours of sunlight in most countries exceeds 1200, meaning that PAPSE approaches are feasible in many places and can be undertaken independently from the power grid.
abstract_zh: 利用太阳能的扶贫项目（PAPSE）有望释放前所未有的资本投资，在能源—贫困—气候的关联中发挥显著的协同作用。1 这些项目在经济上是可行的，因为过去十年间可再生能源发电成本大幅下降；2010至2019年间，太阳能光伏成本下降了82%。此外，大多数国家的年等效利用日照时数超过1200小时，这意味着PAPSE方法在许多地方都是可行的，并且可以独立于电网开展。

Inequitable and heterogeneous impacts on electricity consumption from covid-19 mitigation measures
abstract: The COVID-19 pandemic has exacerbated energy insecurity and economic hardship among vulnerable populations. This paper provides robust empirical evidence of the degree to which COVID-19 mitigation measures, especially the mandates of school closure and limiting business operations, have impacted electricity consumption behavior in low-income and ethnic minority groups in the United States. We use a regression discontinuity design applied to individual-consumer-level high-frequency smart meter data in Arizona and Illinois to highlight the disparities in mitigation measure impacts. We find that the mandates of school closures and limiting business operations increase residential electricity consumption by 4-5%, but reduce commercial electricity consumption by 5-8%. Considerable heterogeneity is observed across income and race: low-income and ethnic-minority populations experience a larger electricity consumption increase, reflecting the disproportionate impact of COVID-19 on electricity insecurity in the residential sector. Policies that address energy insecurity, especially during the pandemic, become essentially important.
abstract_zh: 新冠疫情加剧了弱势群体的能源不安全和经济困境。本文提供了稳健的实证证据，揭示了COVID-19缓解措施，尤其是学校停课和限制营业的命令，在多大程度上影响了美国低收入群体和少数族裔群体的用电行为。我们利用亚利桑那州和伊利诺伊州个体用户层面的高频智能电表数据，采用断点回归设计，以凸显缓解措施影响的差异。我们发现，学校停课和限制营业的命令使居民用电量增加4%–5%，但使商业用电量减少5%–8%。收入和种族之间存在显著的异质性：低收入群体和少数族裔群体的用电量增幅更大，这反映出COVID-19对住宅部门电力不安全状况产生了不成比例的影响。解决能源不安全问题的政策，尤其是在疫情期间，变得至关重要。

title: Social versus private benefits of energy efficiency under time-of-use and increasing block pricing
The impacts of special environmental events on short-run electricity-saving behaviors
abstract: Policymakers and academics are increasingly interested in using ‘social nudges’ to influence behavior, which are typically inexpensive relative to price-based and mandatory approaches. This study provides rigorous empirical evidence of the impacts of three big special environmental events, as a specific form of nudge, on short-run electricity-saving behaviors using high-frequency smart meter data in Shanghai, China, for both residential and commercial consumers. We find that World Environment Day and National Energy Saving Publicity Week caused commercial users to reduce their electricity consumption by 1.35 kWh h−1 and 0.6 kWh h−1 intra-event, around 17% and 8% reduction compared to average consumption, but the impacts decayed rapidly once the events ended. Earth Hour did not lead to significant energy-saving effects for both residential and commercial users. We further examine detailed activities implemented during these events to understand the heterogeneous impacts using social media and policy documents data.
abstract_zh: 决策者和学者日益关注运用“社会助推”（social nudges）来影响行为，这类手段相对于基于价格和强制性的措施通常成本较低。本研究以上海市居民和商业用户的高频智能电表数据为基础，为三个重大特别环境活动这一特定形式的助推，对短期节电行为的影响提供了严格的实证证据。这三个活动分别是世界环境日、全国节能宣传周和地球一小时（Earth Hour）。我们发现，世界环境日和全国节能宣传周期间，商业用户的用电量分别减少1.35千瓦时/小时和0.6千瓦时/小时，约相当于平均用电量的17%和8%，但活动结束后，影响迅速衰减。地球一小时对居民和商业用户均未产生显著的节能效果。我们还利用社交媒体和政策文件数据，考察了这些活动期间实施的具体措施，以理解其异质性影响。

title: Water savings of LEED-certified buildings
Aggregate household behavior in heating and cooling control strategy and energy efficient appliance adoption
abstract: Using nationally representative household survey data administered by the U.S. Energy Information Administration, in this article, we attempt to analyze the aggregate behavior of households in terms of usage of appliances with explicit temperature control mechanism and the adoption of energy-efficient variants of other appliances. A multivariate probit analysis suggests that the households with larger size, higher income, and higher level of education are more likely to use smart thermostat to control temperature and purchase energy-efficient appliances. To identify the broad classes of household behavior, latent class analysis specifications are used. The optimal specification indicates that there are four broad classes of households. Consistent with the results of the multivariate probit specification, we find that the increased odds of belonging to the smart thermostat/energy-efficient appliance owner category of households over the no control/no energy-efficient appliance owner are related to variables, such as household type, size, and income. Therefore, targeting renters, apartment dwellers, and lower income households through appropriate household incentives and residential regulations are likely to improve outcomes in the adoption of efficient appliances and temperature control strategies.
abstract_zh: 本文利用美国能源信息署（EIA）开展的、具有全国代表性的家庭调查数据，分析家庭在使用具有明确温控机制的电器以及采用节能型号其他电器方面的总体行为。多变量Probit分析表明，家庭规模较大、收入较高、受教育程度较高的家庭，更倾向于使用智能恒温器控制温度，并购买节能电器。为识别家庭行为的主要类别，我们采用了潜在类别分析（latent class analysis）。最优设定表明，家庭可分为四大类。与多变量Probit设定的结果一致，我们发现，相对于既不控温又不购买节能电器的家庭，属于“智能恒温器/节能电器拥有者”类别的几率增加，与家庭类型、规模和收入等变量相关。因此，通过适当的家庭激励措施和住宅监管，重点引导租房者、公寓居住者和低收入家庭，有望改善节能电器的采用率和温控策略的推广效果。

title: Increase in domestic electricity consumption from particulate air pollution
Solar photovoltaic interventions have reduced rural poverty in China
abstract: Since 2013, China has implemented a large-scale initiative to systematically deploy solar photovoltaic (PV) projects to alleviate poverty in rural areas. To provide new understanding of China’s targeted poverty alleviation strategy, we use a panel dataset of 211 pilot counties that received targeted PV investments from 2013 to 2016, and find that the PV poverty alleviation pilot policy increases per-capita disposable income in a county by approximately 7%-8%. The effect of PV investment is positive and significant in the year of policy implementation and the effect is more than twice as high in the subsequent two to three years. The PV poverty alleviation effect is stronger in poorer regions, particularly in Eastern China. Our results are robust to alternative specifications and variable definitions. We propose several policy recommendations to sustain progress in China’s efforts to deploy PV for poverty alleviation.
abstract_zh: 太阳能光伏干预措施降低了中国的农村贫困。自 2013 年以来，中国实施了一项大规模倡议，系统性地部署太阳能光伏（PV）项目，以缓解农村地区的贫困。为了深入理解中国精准扶贫战略，我们利用 2013 年至 2016 年间接受精准光伏投资的 211 个试点县的面板数据，发现光伏扶贫试点政策使县域人均可支配收入提高了约 7%–8%。光伏投资的效应在政策实施当年为正且显著，并且在随后的两至三年效应更是高出两倍以上。光伏扶贫效应在较贫困地区尤为显著，尤其是在中国东部。我们的结果在替代设定和变量定义下依然稳健。我们提出了若干政策建议，以维持中国利用光伏推进扶贫工作的成果。

title: Time-of-use electricity pricing and residential low-carbon energy technology adoption
abstract: This paper provides the first empirical evidence on the correlation between Time-Of-Use (TOU) electricity pricing and the adoption of energy efficient appliances and solar panels. We use household-level data in Phoenix, Arizona from an appliance saturation survey of about 16,000 customers conducted by a major electric utility. Our empirical results show that TOU consumers are associated with 27% higher likelihood to install solar panels but not more likely to adopt energy-efficient air conditioning based on the propensity score matching and coarsened exact matching methods. The findings highlight that policy makers could combine TOU and solar panels when implementing educational programs or when giving out financial incentives to consumers. Our results imply that TOU is associated with a similar impact of the incentive offered by $2,070∼$10,472 tax credits or rebates on solar adoption.
abstract_zh: 本文首次提供了关于分时电价（TOU）与节能电器及太阳能板采用之间关联的实证证据。我们使用亚利桑那州凤凰城某主要电力公用事业公司对约16,000名用户进行的电器饱和度调查所得的家庭层面数据。基于倾向得分匹配和粗化精确匹配方法，我们的实证结果表明，分时电价用户安装太阳能板的可能性高出27%，但采用节能空调的可能性并未更高。研究结果表明，政策制定者可以在实施教育项目或发放经济激励时，将分时电价与太阳能板结合起来。我们的结果还表明，分时电价对太阳能采用的影响，与提供2,070至10,472美元税收抵免或返利的激励措施相当。

title: A comparison of building energy codes and policies in the USA, Germany, and China: Progress toward the net-zero building goal in three countries

Loss of profit in the hotel industry of the United States due to climate change
abstract: Tourism has been identified as a key economic sector vulnerable to climate change, yet direct empirical evidence is still lacking on the economic gain and loss of the tourism industry due to climate change. Here we find that temperature significantly affects the profits of the hotel industry with both spatial and seasonal heterogeneity. By using a rich dataset of the monthly financial records of more than 1700 hotels in 50 US states during 2016–2018 (approximately 3.2% of hotels nationally), we show that a deviation from 18 °C ∼ 20 °C in monthly averaged temperature leads to a decrease in the profit rate. The effect is triggered by fewer customers, less revenue, and higher cost per occupied room partially due to the increased usage of electricity and water. Such an effect can be lasting and is less impactful for higher chain scale hotels. In future GHG emission scenarios, climate change will lead to a loss of profit in most climate zones particularly the southern regions, with higher GHG emissions leading to a more serious effect. This study contributes to the literature on how climate change affects human activities and helps refine the relevant damage function of climate change on tourism in existing climate models.
abstract_zh: 旅游业被认为是易受气候变化影响的关键经济部门，但关于气候变化导致旅游业经济得失的直接实证证据仍然缺乏。本文发现，气温对酒店行业利润有显著影响，且存在空间和季节上的异质性。利用2016—2018年美国50个州1700多家酒店（约占全国酒店的3.2%）的月度财务记录数据，我们表明，月平均气温偏离18°C至20°C，会导致利润率下降。这一效应通过顾客减少、收入减少以及每间已入住客房成本上升而产生，其中部分原因是电力和水的用量增加。这种效应可能具有持续性，且对高端连锁酒店的影响较小。在未来的温室气体排放情景下，气候变化将导致大多数气候区的利润减少，尤其是南部地区，且温室气体排放越高，影响越严重。本研究丰富了关于气候变化如何影响人类活动的文献，并有助于在现有气候模型中完善气候变化对旅游业的损害函数。

Consumers' attitudes towards surcharges on distributed renewable energy generation and energy efficiency programs
abstract: Increasing penetration of energy efficiency programs and distributed renewable energy generation has imposed significant challenges for utilities to recoup their large upfront costs. There is a heated debate on what surcharges should be implemented to help the utilities recover their fixed costs; however, very few studies focus on consumers’ attitudes regarding this topic. This study surveys about 190 residential consumers throughout the United States in November 2015, investigating their preferences and attitudes towards extra demand charges and volumetric energy price increases. We apply probit models and regress consumers’ attitudes on selected socio-demographic and behavioral variables. The results indicate the homeowners are more likely to prefer demand charges when compared to renters. The demographic and behavioral factors impact consumers’ perception of bill savings from energy efficiency programs or solar panel installation and also influence how consumers perceive the fairness of utilities recovering revenue losses by increasing volumetric energy price. In this paper, we demonstrate there is preference heterogeneity among consumers and that policy makers should be aware of such preference heterogeneity and apply policy targeting based on the identified demographics and behavioral factors impacting consumer preferences.
abstract_zh: 能效项目和分布式可再生能源发电的普及，给公用事业公司收回其高昂的前期成本带来了重大挑战。关于应实施何种附加费以帮助公用事业公司回收固定成本，存在激烈的争论；然而，很少有研究关注消费者对此问题的态度。本研究于2015年11月对美国各地约190名居民用户进行了调查，考察他们对额外需量电费（demand charges）和按用量计价的电价上涨的偏好与态度。我们应用Probit模型，将消费者态度对所选的社会人口学和行为变量进行回归。结果表明，与租房者相比，房主更倾向于接受需量电费。人口统计学和行为因素影响消费者对能效项目或太阳能板安装所带来账单节省的感知，也影响其对公用事业公司通过提高按用量计价电价来弥补收入损失是否公平的看法。本文表明，消费者之间存在偏好异质性，政策制定者应当注意这种偏好异质性，并依据影响消费者偏好的已识别人口与行为因素实施有针对性的政策。

title: Factors influencing commercial buildings to obtain green certificates
abstract: Identifying the key factors that influence commercial buildings’ decision to obtain voluntary green certificates is essential to building sustainability enhancement. Using commercial buildings in the state of New York, multinomial logit and nested logit models demonstrate that there is a significant correlation between the characteristics of commercial buildings (such as square footage, lot size, and years built) and green certification. More interestingly, if a commercial building is occupied by its owner, likelihood of green certification is actually smaller. This finding not only confirms that ongoing energy savings are heavily discounted when deciding whether to incur the upfront cost of green certification, but also suggests that the rental premium enjoyed by green buildings is likely greater in terms of present value than the expected operating cost savings. Another explanation could be that investor owners must operate in a competitive market for tenants while owner-occupiers do not operate in that competitive market, so they do not need to obtain green certificates to attract tenants. Consequently for policymakers, building owners that plan to rent out their commercial property space should be the early targets to promote green certification.
abstract_zh: 识别影响商业建筑决定获取自愿性绿色认证的关键因素，对于提升建筑可持续性至关重要。利用纽约州的商业建筑数据，多项Logit模型和嵌套Logit模型表明，商业建筑的特征（如建筑面积、地块面积和建造年份）与绿色认证之间存在显著相关性。更有意思的是，若商业建筑由业主自住，其获得绿色认证的可能性反而更小。这一发现不仅证实了在决定是否承担绿色认证的前期成本时，持续的节能收益会被大幅折现，还表明，从现值来看，绿色建筑享有的租金溢价可能大于预期的运营成本节约。另一种解释是，出租型业主必须在竞争激烈的租户市场中经营，而自住业主并不处于这一竞争性市场中，因此无需获得绿色认证来吸引租户。因此，对政策制定者而言，计划出租商业物业空间的建筑业主，应成为推动绿色认证的优先目标。

title: Has government intervention effectively encouraged the use of waste cooking oil as an energy source? Comparison of two Chinese biofuel companies
How have political incentives for local officials reduced environmental pollution in resource-depleted cities?
abstract: Chinese resource-exhausted cities face more severe environmental pollution problems than other cities. In addressing these problems, the way local officials (usually senior party and government leaders) operate is very important, as their focus on political achievements may complicate how they manage environmental pollution in these cities. On the one hand, the traditional Gross Domestic Product-based quest for political achievement may lead top leaders to de-emphasize environmental pollution. On the other hand, changes made in 2003 to the way the performance of Chinese officials is evaluated have encouraged some local senior party and government leaders to pay more attention to environmental problems. Based on this, we analyze the relationship between political incentives and environmental pollution by applying the 2004–2014 panel data from 37 resource-exhausted cities. The findings reveal that firstly, among the factors which impact the environmental pollution of resource-exhausted cities, investment in fixed assets, foreign direct investment, industrial structure, per-capita education expenditure, and population density do not have a significant impact, thus indicating that local openness levels, the degree of industrial upgrading, and local investment in fixed assets are not the key variables in environmental pollution control. Secondly, the extent to which officials vie for political achievement affects environmental pollution in resource-exhausted cities. This depends upon whether the officials are municipal party secretaries or mayors; the former play a greater dynamic role in environmental pollution and have stronger robustness than the latter. The conclusion verifies both the existing authority structure of China and its effectiveness in the control of environmental pollution of resource-exhausted cities. That is to say, in contrast to the principles of the party committees, the mayors are in a subordinate position and often fail to fully and effectively exercise their functions. Accordingly, we point out that the selection of municipal party secretaries, rather than mayors, is particularly important in coming to terms with local environmental pollution.
abstract_zh: 中国资源枯竭型城市面临的环境污染问题比其他城市更为严重。在应对这些问题时，地方官员（通常为党委和政府主要领导）的行事方式至关重要，因为他们对政治业绩的追求可能使其在管理这些城市的环境污染时更加复杂。一方面，传统的以国内生产总值（GDP）为基础的政绩追求，可能导致高层领导忽视环境污染问题。另一方面，2003年中国官员考核方式的改变，促使部分地方党政主要领导更加关注环境问题。基于此，我们运用2004—2014年37个资源枯竭型城市的面板数据，分析政治激励与环境污染之间的关系。研究发现：第一，在影响资源枯竭型城市环境污染的因素中，固定资产投资、外商直接投资、产业结构、人均教育支出和人口密度均不具有显著影响，这表明地方开放程度、产业升级程度以及地方固定资产投资，并非环境污染治理的关键变量。第二，官员争夺政治业绩的程度会影响资源枯竭型城市的环境污染，这取决于官员是市委书记还是市长：前者在环境污染治理中发挥的动态作用更大，且稳健性更强。该结论既印证了中国现有的权力结构，也证明了其在控制资源枯竭型城市环境污染方面的有效性。也就是说，与党委的原则相比，市长处于从属地位，往往未能充分而有效地履行其职能。因此，我们指出，在解决地方环境污染问题上，选拔市委书记而非市长尤为重要。

abstract: Empirical evidence is provided to show that peer effects have statistically significant and positive impacts on the diffusion of green building certificates. Application and approval records of green certificates by commercial buildings in NY and AZ are used. The challenge of self-selection is addressed by the usage of fixed effects and the challenge of reflection is addressed by the time lag delay between a building’s application and its approval. Empirical results show that an additional approved LEED certificate within a zip code will increase the probability of a commercial building in the same zip code to apply for a LEED certificate by 3–4 percentage points; an additional approved Energy Star certificate within a zip code will increase the probability of a commercial building in the same zip code to apply for an Energy Star certificate by 1–2 percentage points.

Implied discount rate and payback threshold of energy efficiency investment in the industrial sector
abstract: The industrial sector is responsible for about a third of the energy usage in the United States, and there is significant energy saving potential from the industrial sector. However, the phenomenon of “energy efficiency gap” – the scenario in which cost-effective energy efficient technologies enjoy only limited market success – appears frequently in the industrial sector. This article tries to explain this efficiency gap in the industrial sector by empirically estimating the implied discount rates and payback thresholds industrial firms use to evaluate their energy efficiency investments. Using the Industrial Assessment Centers (IAC) database from 2002 to 2011, with more than 30 000 energy efficiency recommendations, this article builds structural models of firms’ evaluation of an energy efficiency project. The model results show that the implied discount rates of medium to small industrial firms range from 40 to 45%, and the average payback threshold is about 9 months.
abstract_zh: 工业部门约占美国能源使用量的三分之一，其节能潜力巨大。然而，“能效差距”现象——即具有成本效益的节能技术仅取得有限市场成功的情形——在工业部门中频繁出现。本文通过实证估计工业企业在评估其能效投资时所使用的隐含贴现率和回收期阈值，试图解释工业部门中的这一能效差距。利用2002—2011年工业评估中心（IAC）数据库中超过3万条能效建议，本文构建了企业评估能效项目的结构模型。模型结果显示，中小型工业企业的隐含贴现率介于40%至45%之间，平均回收期阈值约为9个月。
